title: Build backend requirement with no version constraint
description: pyproject.toml declares a build requirement that names only the package. The build backend runs arbitrary code before the project is packaged, and an unpinned one pulls whatever the index serves.
remediation: Pin the build requirements to the versions the project tested.
limitation: It matches a build requirement that names only the package in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
